blind.B1: Yes, as an exercise-mediator (runner plasma RP vs control plasma CP, in vivo plasma transfer into non-running recipients; recipients do not exercise). Series GSE164401 hippocampus LPS experiment: 31 samples, SAL+SAL, LPS+SAL, LPS+CP, LPS+RP; RP is the exercise-conditioned factor (S2.p1, S6.3.p1, Fig.2a).
blind.B2: LPS vs control (SAL+SAL n=8 vs LPS+SAL n=8; 4,936 DEGs) and RP vs CP under LPS (LPS+CP n=7 vs LPS+RP n=8), Fig.2b legend (S2.p1).
blind.B3: Paper treats each sample as one mouse (n=8/group). Titles carry an L index (4 per group) and _1/_2 suffix (2 per L), i.e. 4 L x 2 = 8; L is nested in group, so it could be a cage (mice housed in pairs, S6.2.p1) or a technical grouping; the paper does not say. No documented repeated measure.
blind.B4: Paper does not state joint vs pairwise fits; S6.9.p1 only says 'DESeq2 ... using built-in algorithms'. Fig.2b legend lists four groups together; a joint 4-level fit is plausible but unstated.
blind.B5: 'Wald test, P < 0.05' (Fig.2b legend), raw P, no fold-change cutoff. LPS effect: 4,936 DEGs (S2.p1). RP vs CP under LPS count not given in text (Supplementary Table 4).

checks.evidence: Runs as plasma-transfer exercise-mediator; analysis labels caveat that recipients did not exercise and LPS vs SAL is only the reference contrast.
Groups 8/8/7/8 match Fig.2b legend (n=8,8,7,8); GEO treatment column (all 'RP') rejected in favour of title; CP is the correct LPS-matched control; no exclusions.
LPSRP vs LPSCP (ctrl CP) and LPSSAL vs SALSAL (ctrl SALSAL); treatment-over-control ordering.

L1-L16 nested in group (L3,7,11,15=LPS+CP etc.); paper n=8 mice/group matches 4 L x 2, so _1/_2 are counted as separate mice; analysis tested expression neighbours and treated as independent. If L is a cage of two mice, cluster effect is ignored, but paper does the same.
checks.fix: Optional sensitivity: cluster-robust or L-aware check, labelled assumption; not required.

checks.evidence: Paper does not state joint vs pairwise fits; S6.9.p1 only says 'DESeq2 ... using built-in algorithms'. Analysis used one joint ~grp model on all 31 samples (one dispersion fit) and recorded this as a deviation/assumption.
checks.fix: Optionally report pairwise fits for LPSRP vs LPSCP as sensitivity.

summary: 决定与论文一致：分组(8/8/7/8)、方向、阈值(Wald原始P<0.05)和原始计数矩阵均正确，LPS对照4709对4936基本吻合。L编号嵌套于组内，可能是笼，但论文同样按独立小鼠处理，仅列为次要提示。总体通过，开放的策略问题交人工。
